description: LLM second-brain vault scaffold: seed pages, agent snippets, and setup docs for multi-agent knowledge management. Also proactively wires Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cursor by default: a SessionStart-equivalent hook auto-loads wiki/hot.md + wiki/index.md into every session, and a marked persona-file section instructs the agent when to query/file learnings via the qmd MCP tools. OpenCode gets the persona-file section only (no session-start hook API is available for OpenCode).
secret_policy: Never installs auth tokens, credentials, API keys, local router URLs, or machine-specific paths. Vault data is create-if-absent and never uninstall-deleted.
notes: Vault content (seed pages, .gitignore, raw/, wiki/) is created only if absent. Uninstall never deletes vault data, .git history, or user-authored pages. As of 0.2.0, install() also offers (interactive prompt, respects --yes/--no-hooks) to register a Claude Code SessionStart hook and merge a marked section into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; both are idempotent, uninstall-reversible, and can also be enabled standalone via 'vibe kits second-brain enable-hook'. As of 0.3.0, the same offer also wires Codex CLI (~/.codex/config.toml SessionStart hook + ~/.codex/AGENTS.md section) and Cursor (~/.cursor/hooks.json sessionStart hook + a fully kit-owned ~/.cursor/rules/second-brain.mdc file), and merges an AGENTS.md section for OpenCode (no hook — OpenCode has no session-start context-injection API per current docs). Each agent's config is validated independently; one agent's invalid config never blocks the others.
